summary: De-esser with a band-pass detector on the sibilance band: Relative (the band's level against the whole signal's, for vocals: it follows the singer's level) or Absolute (the band's level against the threshold). The reduction is made on a split band (minimum phase, or linear phase with latency) or on the whole signal as a dynamic high shelf or bell. Lookahead, Listen (hear what the detector hears), Delta (hear only what is taken out) and a gain-match reading. Use it for sibilance on vocals, harsh cymbals and hats, or a bright master.
use_for: Tame harsh s and t sounds in vocals and bright sources.

parameters.name: Detector
parameters.description: Relative: the band's level against the whole signal's (follows the singer). Absolute: the band's level in dBFS

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Width of the band in octaves: the detector's band, the split band and the bell

parameters.name: Threshold
parameters.description: Where reduction starts: Relative, the band's level under the whole signal's; Absolute, dBFS

parameters.name: Ratio
parameters.description: How much of the excess is taken out: 1 nothing, 20 nearly all

parameters.name: Action
parameters.description: Split: only the band is reduced, minimum phase, no latency of its own. Split linear: the band by a linear-phase filter (latency 255 samples). Shelf: a dynamic high shelf on the whole signal. Bell: a dynamic bell

parameters.name: Max reduction
parameters.description: The most the de-esser takes out

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: How fast the reduction comes in

parameters.name: Lookahead
parameters.description: Delays the audio so the reduction is in place when the sibilant arrives (latency)

parameters.name: Listen
parameters.description: Hear the band the detector hears

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Gain after the de-esser, 0.1 dB steps (the editor's Match sets it from the gain-match reading)

parameters.name: Delta
parameters.description: Hear only what the de-esser takes out: the output minus the input, delayed to match (glides over 10 ms)

readings.description: The reduction now, dB (0 or more)
The lookahead (plus the linear-phase split's 255), reported to NeoBuzz Live
